title: District Information System
summary: Reporting, membership and performance assessment for a district of 68 clubs, replacing a listing website that was being used as an MIS.
problem: A district of 68 clubs was running reporting on a platform assessed as a listing website used as a management information system. It had no scoring engine, no exports, and serious data-protection gaps.
approach: Privacy and auditability as the foundation rather than features: every read scoped by club and role, every write logged, and the Rotary year modelled explicitly so history is archived, never overwritten.
highlights: Data access scoped per club and per role.
Annual rollover that archives a year rather than overwriting it.
Built and demonstrated on synthetic data; ownership transfers to the district on acceptance.
